title: ForensicReport (report.v1)
description: Story 4.4 DFIR forensic report (FR43). AUTHORITATIVE validation source for the DFIR sub-agent response contract; forensic_report.yaml is the human-readable mirror and internal/report/dfir/forensic_report_schema.json is the byte-identical embedded runtime copy. This is the MODEL-facing report schema: the LLM returns a single JSON document conforming to it, which the DFIR runner validates and then RENDERS deterministically to YAML-front-matter + Markdown (BI-6 JSON->render hybrid; the LLM never controls raw Markdown). The factual report sections (kill-chain timeline, containment actions, MITRE ATT&CK annotations) are built DETERMINISTICALLY in Go from the IncidentFinalised event history and the persisted ThreatAssessment; the model supplies ONLY the interpretive narrative (round-1 review follow-up: anti-hallucination). The deterministic front-matter fields (incident_id, final_fsm_state, threat_score_at_decision, attack_techniques, contributing_posture_findings, containment_actions, report_generated_at, prompt_hash, dfir_provider, dfir_model) are sourced from the IncidentFinalised event and the persisted ThreatAssessment/WorkloadPosture, not invented by the model (AC2): the runner force-stamps the authoritative values after validation. attack_techniques items use the established ATT&CK string form (threat_assessment.json mitre_techniques regex), pinned to MITRE ATT&CK for Containers v18. final_fsm_state EXCLUDES CLEAN (CLEAN never finalises, AC4). narrative is the analyst interpretive prose only (NOT the factual sections, which the renderer assembles). Source of truth for the Go shape: internal/report/dfir/report.go (type ForensicReport).

schema_version.description: Stamped to report.v1 by the runner; optional (or null) from the model.

incident_id.description: Identifier of the finalised incident (the IncidentFinalised package_id).

final_fsm_state.description: The non-CLEAN FSM state the workload settled in (CLEAN never finalises, AC4).

threat_score_at_decision.description: The ThreatScore on the transition that established the final state, captured at entry, not re-sampled.

attack_techniques.description: MITRE ATT&CK for Containers technique annotations (FR43), sourced from the persisted ThreatAssessment.MitreTechniques.

contributing_posture_findings.description: Contributing posture findings (RBAC bindings, NetworkPolicies, PodSecurityContext) at the time of the incident.

containment_actions.description: The containment actions Olaitan took (the non-CLEAN states reached, optional checkpoint), derived from the FSM history.

report_generated_at.description: The report generation time (the DFIR runner clock).

dfir_provider.description: The provider that served the DFIR call (e.g. claude).

dfir_model.description: The model id that served the DFIR call.

narrative.description: The interpretive analyst narrative prose ONLY: a plain-language account of how the activity proceeded, grounded strictly in the supplied evidence and the control-plane prior_assessment record. The factual sections (kill-chain timeline, containment actions, MITRE ATT&CK annotations) are assembled deterministically by the Go renderer, NOT by the model (round-1 review follow-up: anti-hallucination). Where data is absent the narrative states the gap rather than fabricating a value.
